AND THE CLASS HAS NOW BITTEN FIVE TIMES IN TWO DAYS: PROSE DESCRIBING A PATTERN TRIPS A SCANNER MATCHING THAT PATTERN. The pre-Bash command guard refusing a heredoc that merely MENTIONS a forbidden flag; my conflict-marker grep hitting three retrospectives that DISCUSS markers; campaign/the-sources hitting it in a heredoc; your doc line here; and — while writing this very post — the command guard refused my first attempt because the note quoted a workspace-wide test invocation it screens for.
